review_mode: Independent delegated AI source reading and existing synthetic test evidence; no code execution or actual-output audit

tests.scope: Wrapper tests mock only the completed-bundle regeneration boundary. Pure arithmetic and sidecar-role functions execute against temporary fixtures. They do not establish actual stage or live runtime integration.

checks.reason: Requires exact remaining bundle version/purpose/status and one of five declared slots, finds exactly one current stage worker specification, re-runs the SHA-pinned actual remaining guard, compares every regenerated bundle field except creation timestamp, then rehashes all input refs.

UBS E F0 uses the guarded fixed_previous_completion_segment path and original old declaration reference; stage/case name, declared old run and different parent are explicit. Its math sidecar resolves under old declaration.output_root, not current reports. Full five-plus-eight exact historic authority and saved F0 message constraints remain enforced by the called remaining guard.

L/C F0 require same_remaining_run and identical run parent with current stage, exact own-case D0 folder and matching declaration reference. D0 has no invented prior. New UBS E D0 is outside the five-slot domain.

Uses exact existing pure implementation by SHA10ee4d79..., including bounded Decimal/Fraction parsing, official sector order, proportional normalization, deterministic largest remainder, raw diagnostics and independently compared accepted sidecar. No arithmetic implementation or model history rewritten.

Current and prior sidecars are separately bound to their own declared output path, case/stage/transport and artifact hashes. Numerical disagreement is returned as matches:false; it is not silently repaired or a semantic success score. Missing sidecar fails without invented values.

Raw versus derived own-D0 differences and three benchmark comparator definitions remain separate. Covariance quadratic forms use exact serialized fractions; square roots are labeled60-digit approximations. Daily raw observations unavailable, so means/covariances/compound returns are not claimed to be re-estimated from daily source data.

All input and implementation refs are rehashed at end. CLI serializes completely with safe ASCII/finite JSON before exclusive new output under remaining namespace; old raw/sidecar files are never changed.

errors.reason: No blocking defect found in the complete wrapper/tests or the reused numeric and role-binding code inspected. The12-test receipt binds current source/test and covers live/wrong-purpose/new-E-D0 rejection, guard mismatch, cross-case/prior declaration/provenance substitution, missing prior sidecar and retained numeric disagreement.

consistency.reason: Mandatory guard regeneration preserves frozen source visibility and exact worker/response authority. E prior D0 and its math/declaration remain in the earlier completion segment; L/C use their own new run. Exact parser/arithmetic hashes match reviewed originals, and raw versus derived diagnostics remain distinct.

paper_topic.reason: Provides numerical evidence for checking institution reading, stated reason and raw/derived sector allocation. It grades no prose, gives no entailment/composite/correctness score, does not infer model use of external normalization, and makes no future-performance, causal or independent-human-validation claim.

limitations: Static review plus existing synthetic receipts; no actual remaining response, bundle or numerical result was opened or generated.
The guarded actual completed stage and exact current/own-D0 sidecars still require validation when the stage becomes durable.
The12 wrapper tests deliberately mock guard regeneration and cannot replace frozen gate/runtime validation.
Source fidelity and contextual entailment require separate reading against visible evidence; matching IDs and arithmetic do not certify those claims.
